restart_policy: A chain is complete only when its full file (exactly 32*n_meas bytes) and stdout JSON were captured and hashed on persistent storage. A failed or timed-out chain leaves no completed file and is never analysed. Rerunning a task reuses the same seed and is bit-identical; reruns are submitted only within the remaining authorized ceiling. Ensembles are analysed with all complete chains if >= 8 are complete (controls: all).
